note: کوئری‌های گزارشِ «اقتصادِ واحد» (۲۰ شهریور ۱۴۰۵). همه روی اتصالِ readonly از workflow `Ops` اکشن `db-query` اجرا شدند (کاربر SSH ندارد). قاعده‌ی آهنین: هیچ عددی از حافظه.
excludeUsers: مالک و حساب‌های تست — همان لیستِ state.json
rule: هرجا هزینه و درآمد کنارِ هم می‌آیند باید هر دو از پنجره‌ی llm_usage خوانده شوند؛ وگرنه درآمدِ ۶۵ روز با هزینه‌ی ۱۲ روز مقایسه می‌شود و عدد خوش‌بینانه و بی‌معنا درمی‌آید.

1_channels_and_cost.sql:
WITH
adm(id) AS (VALUES (429557996),(409581917),(100257975),(5725984933)),
u AS (
  SELECT telegram_id AS uid, created_at AS t, balance AS bal,
    CASE WHEN first_source LIKE 'campaign:%' THEN 'campaign'
         WHEN first_source LIKE 'referral:%' THEN 'referral'
         ELSE 'organic' END AS ch,
    CASE WHEN first_source='' THEN '(empty)' ELSE first_source END AS src
  FROM users WHERE telegram_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM adm)
),
pay AS (SELECT user_id AS uid, SUM(amount) AS amt, COUNT(*) AS n
        FROM payments WHERE status='approved' GROUP BY 1),
rd  AS (SELECT user_id AS uid, SUM(price) AS gems, COUNT(*) AS n
        FROM readings WHERE status='delivered' AND price>0 GROUP BY 1),
lu  AS (SELECT user_id AS uid, SUM(cost_usd) AS usd, COUNT(*) AS calls FROM llm_usage GROUP BY 1),
gfk AS (SELECT user_id AS uid, json_extract(props,'$.kind') AS k,
               SUM(CAST(json_extract(props,'$.amount') AS INTEGER)) AS amt, COUNT(*) AS n
        FROM events WHERE event='credit_granted' AND json_valid(props) GROUP BY 1,2),
gf  AS (SELECT uid, SUM(amt) AS free FROM gfk GROUP BY 1),
lus AS (SELECT MIN(created_at) AS t0, MAX(created_at) AS t1 FROM llm_usage)

SELECT '1_channel' AS sec, u.ch AS a, CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT) AS b,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN pay.amt>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TEXT) AS c,
  CAST(COALESCE(SUM(pay.amt),0) AS TEXT) AS d,
  CAST(COALESCE(SUM(gf.free),0) AS TEXT) AS e,
  CAST(COALESCE(SUM(rd.gems),0) AS TEXT) AS f,
  CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(lu.usd),0),4) AS TEXT) AS g,
  CAST(COALESCE(SUM(rd.n),0) AS TEXT) AS h,
  CAST(COALESCE(SUM(u.bal),0) AS TEXT) AS i
FROM u LEFT JOIN pay ON pay.uid=u.uid LEFT JOIN rd ON rd.uid=u.uid
       LEFT JOIN lu ON lu.uid=u.uid LEFT JOIN gf ON gf.uid=u.uid
GROUP BY 1,2

UNION ALL
SELECT '2_giftkind', u.ch, COALESCE(gfk.k,'?'), CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT u.uid) AS TEXT),
  CAST(SUM(gfk.amt) AS TEXT), CAST(SUM(gfk.n) AS TEXT), '', '', '', ''
FROM u JOIN gfk ON gfk.uid=u.uid GROUP BY 2,3

UNION ALL
SELECT '3_refledger','rewards_paid_diamonds', CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT uid) AS TEXT),
  CAST(SUM(amt) AS TEXT), CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT), '', '', '', '', ''
FROM gfk WHERE k='referral'

UNION ALL
SELECT '3_refledger','referrals_table', CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT),
  CAST(SUM(rewarded) AS TEXT), CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT referrer_id) AS TEXT),
  CAST(MIN(created_at) AS TEXT), CAST(MAX(created_at) AS TEXT), '', '', ''
FROM referrals

UNION ALL
SELECT '3_refledger','referrers_revenue', CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT r.referrer_id) AS TEXT),
  CAST(COALESCE(SUM(p.amt),0) AS TEXT),
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.amt>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TEXT), '', '', '', '', ''
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT referrer_id FROM referrals) r
LEFT JOIN pay p ON p.uid=r.referrer_id
WHERE r.referrer_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM adm)

UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT '4_campaign' AS sec, u.src AS a, CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT) AS b,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN pay.amt>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TEXT) AS c,
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(pay.amt),0) AS TEXT) AS d,
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(gf.free),0) AS TEXT) AS e,
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(rd.gems),0) AS TEXT) AS f,
    CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(lu.usd),0),4) AS TEXT) AS g,
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(rd.n),0) AS TEXT) AS h,
    CAST(MIN(u.t) AS TEXT) AS i
  FROM u LEFT JOIN pay ON pay.uid=u.uid LEFT JOIN rd ON rd.uid=u.uid
         LEFT JOIN lu ON lu.uid=u.uid LEFT JOIN gf ON gf.uid=u.uid
  WHERE u.ch='campaign' GROUP BY 2 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 45
)

UNION ALL
SELECT '5_kind', kind, CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT), CAST(SUM(prompt_tokens) AS TEXT),
  CAST(SUM(completion_tokens) AS TEXT), CAST(ROUND(SUM(cost_usd),4) AS TEXT),
  CAST(ROUND(AVG(cost_usd),6) AS TEXT), CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS TEXT),
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN user_id=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TEXT), ''
FROM llm_usage GROUP BY 2

UNION ALL
SELECT '6_retry', CAST(c AS TEXT), CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT), CAST(ROUND(SUM(usd),4) AS TEXT),
  CAST(ROUND(AVG(usd),6) AS TEXT), '', '', '', '', ''
FROM (SELECT ref_id, COUNT(*) AS c, SUM(cost_usd) AS usd FROM llm_usage
      WHERE kind='reading' AND ref_id>0 GROUP BY 1)
GROUP BY 2

UNION ALL
SELECT '7_model', model, CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT), CAST(ROUND(SUM(cost_usd),4) AS TEXT),
  CAST(SUM(prompt_tokens) AS TEXT), CAST(SUM(completion_tokens) AS TEXT),
  CAST(ROUND(AVG(ms),0) AS TEXT), '', '', ''
FROM llm_usage GROUP BY 2

UNION ALL
SELECT '8_span','llm_usage', CAST((SELECT t0 FROM lus) AS TEXT), CAST((SELECT t1 FROM lus) AS TEXT),
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT), CAST(ROUND(SUM(cost_usd),4) AS TEXT), '', '', '', ''
FROM llm_usage
UNION ALL
SELECT '8_span','users', CAST(MIN(t) AS TEXT), CAST(MAX(t) AS TEXT), CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT),
  CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS TEXT), '', '', '', '' FROM u
UNION ALL
SELECT '8_span','payments_approved', CAST(MIN(created_at) AS TEXT), CAST(MAX(created_at) AS TEXT),
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT), CAST(SUM(amount) AS TEXT), '', '', '', ''
FROM payments WHERE status='approved'
UNION ALL
SELECT '8_span','readings_delivered', CAST(MIN(created_at) AS TEXT), CAST(MAX(created_at) AS TEXT),
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT), CAST(SUM(price) AS TEXT), '', '', '', ''
FROM readings WHERE status='delivered' AND price>0

UNION ALL
SELECT '9_inwindow', u.ch, CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT),
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN pay.amt>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TEXT),
  CAST(COALESCE(SUM(pay.amt),0) AS TEXT),
  CAST(COALESCE(SUM(gf.free),0) AS TEXT),
  CAST(COALESCE(SUM(rd.gems),0) AS TEXT),
  CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(lu.usd),0),4) AS TEXT),
  CAST(COALESCE(SUM(rd.n),0) AS TEXT), ''
FROM u LEFT JOIN pay ON pay.uid=u.uid LEFT JOIN rd ON rd.uid=u.uid
       LEFT JOIN lu ON lu.uid=u.uid LEFT JOIN gf ON gf.uid=u.uid
WHERE u.t >= (SELECT t0 FROM lus) GROUP BY 2

UNION ALL
SELECT '10_size', CAST(r.price AS TEXT), CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT),
  CAST(ROUND(SUM(x.usd),4) AS TEXT), CAST(ROUND(AVG(x.usd),6) AS TEXT),
  CAST(ROUND(AVG(x.calls),2) AS TEXT), CAST(ROUND(AVG(x.ptok),0) AS TEXT),
  CAST(ROUND(AVG(x.ctok),0) AS TEXT), '', ''
FROM readings r JOIN (
  SELECT ref_id, SUM(cost_usd) AS usd, COUNT(*) AS calls,
         SUM(prompt_tokens) AS ptok, SUM(completion_tokens) AS ctok
  FROM llm_usage WHERE ref_id>0 AND kind IN ('reading','repair','transcribe','feedback') GROUP BY 1
) x ON x.ref_id=r.id
WHERE r.status='delivered' GROUP BY 2

UNION ALL
SELECT '11_repair','readings_with_repair', CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT ref_id) AS TEXT),
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT), CAST(ROUND(SUM(cost_usd),4) AS TEXT), '', '', '', '', ''
FROM llm_usage WHERE kind='repair'

UNION ALL
SELECT '12_feedback', COALESCE(feedback,''), CAST(COUNT(*) AS TEXT), '', '', '', '', '', '', ''
FROM readings WHERE status='delivered' AND price>0 GROUP BY 2

gotchas: ⛔ هر کوئری‌ای که `events` را با جدولِ دیگری JOIN کند روی این دیتابیس **اجرانشدنی** است: یک نسخه‌اش بیش از ۹ دقیقه دوید و لغو شد. `events` ایندکسی روی `event` یا `user_id` ندارد و میدل‌ورِ جرنی هر پیام را ثبت می‌کند، پس جدول میلیونی است. برای قیفِ per کانال یا ایندکس لازم است یا کوئریِ دو مرحله‌ای.
خروجیِ db-query سقفِ ۲۰۰ ردیف چاپ دارد؛ هر بخشِ UNION باید فشرده بماند.
پیش از هر dispatch، کوئری را روی یک SQLite محلی با همان DDL اجرا کن. یک خطای سینتکس یک جابِ کاملِ Actions را می‌سوزاند.
⚠️ ستونِ campaign_costs.usd یک **نرخ per کاربرِ کمپین** است، نه خرجِ کلِ آن روز (خودِ فرمِ داشبورد همین را می‌خواهد). خواندنش به‌عنوان خرجِ کل، هزینه‌ی تبلیغ را ده‌ها برابر غلط می‌کند.
⚠️ سرخطِ فال با LIKE سنجیده شد نه با خودِ headlineOk؛ آن تابع شش واژه‌ی شرطی و دو گاردِ جهت دارد و تطبیقش **کلمه‌ای** است نه زیررشته‌ای. عددِ بندِ ۶د یک کرانه است، نه اندازه‌گیریِ دقیق.
